    • assignTaskToChef

      public static void assignTaskToChef(Chef chef, Task task)
      Assigns a task to a Chef and sends a notification to the Chef about the task. This method adds a notification to the Chef's notification list and increments the Chef's workload.
      Parameters:
      chef - The Chef to whom the task is assigned.
      task - The task that is assigned to the Chef.
